sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:158

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:158:1
items.html: And we will begin to explain the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of ZA in the discernment of the four worlds ABYA: Behold, up to here he explained the matter of the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of BYA that they received from Ima through the clothing in the ZON of Atzilut — that the ten Sefirot of Neshama clothed in Beria, and the ten Sefirot of Ruach in Yetzira, and the ten Sefirot of Nefesh in Assiya — and they came out one from the other in the discernment of seal, as above. And now he begins to explain the discernment of the light of Haya that clothes in these Partzufim of BYA, for this reached them from the discernment of the clothing of the Partzuf of the posterior of the Nukva of Atzilut at the time of the diminution of the moon, as written in the item that follows.
